verdict.rationale: Lorikeet's trust page states it has zero-data-retention agreements with all model vendors and does no fine-tuning on customer data. That keeps customer data out of AI model training by default, so no opt-out is needed. The claim comes from a single first-party sentence with no detailed policy or contractual documentation behind it. Missing for 10: detailed data-use or DPA documentation spelling out the training exclusions, explicit coverage of Lorikeet's own non-fine-tuning model improvement (e.g., Coach learning loops), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
